title: Teaching clarinet and the stroke that ended it
summary: His first elementary pupil, Ruzon's son, is graduating in music, but a stroke weakened his eyes so he cannot teach.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: One of my scholars is going to graduate at college. He's graduating music. How do you call his son? Oscar Ruzon. Ruzon. That's right. Ruzon's son. He's one of your scholars? Yeah. He's the first one I started in elementary. Did you teach mostly clarinet or sax? No, I started teaching clarinet. Yeah. And he's going to graduate in music. He's going to graduate in music sometime this June, I believe.
Did you have a lot of scholars, Taz? Who? Did you have a lot of pupils? No, I ain't got no more.

I ain't got no more scholars. I can't teach no more. My eyes is not good. No. My eyes is not good no more. I had a stroke. When I had a stroke, my eyes affected. So I can't. All I have to do is read the headline.
